snippet.title: Dumpster Divers Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into alley and dumpsters with up to 4 friends in this online co-op scavenging game, where rejected puppets turn trash into treasure.

Outsmart bumbling cops, and haul your loot home to sell. Use scraps to craft helpful tools, and climb the ranks of society one dumpster at a time.

Music: Cosmic Boy by Jairo. Listen to the original here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PnvVPv_EODw
